title: Musical cousin Joe Loyacano
summary: Asked about uncles, he names his older cousin Joe, who played a chord instrument and shared his style.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Uh, did any of your uncles play music? Yeah.
No, Cousins. Cousins. What instrument was that?
Cousins. Joe, he played a chord in.
Joseph. Joseph Lloyd Cannon. Joseph Lloyd Cannon.
Just like your brother. Yeah. Mm-hmm. Did he play any other instrument? I didn't know.
And, uh... My poetry go with him, you know. Oh, yeah. Even my poetry style together.
I guess he was a little older than you, your cousin Joe?
